passages.title: Reading Posters and Infographics
passages.text: A school poster advertised a three-day reading challenge. Its chart listed registrations: Monday, 24 students; Tuesday, 31 students; Wednesday, 39 students. The poster also stated that each session lasted 20 minutes and that students should bring their own books. A note below the chart explained that registrations were recorded before each session, so they were not the same as confirmed attendance. The source was the school library team. The poster did not provide numbers for Thursday or Friday.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the poster description?
choices: To explain information presented in a short event poster
To list ingredients for a recipe
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.
questions.evidence: A school poster advertised a three-day reading challenge.

questions.prompt: How many students registered on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: Daftar angka menempatkan 31 siswa pada hari Selasa.

questions.prompt: What is the important limitation of the chart?
choices: It counts registrations rather than confirmed attendance
questions.explanation: Catatan poster membedakan pendaftaran dan kehadiran.

choices: Grafik menghitung pendaftaran, bukan kehadiran terkonfirmasi

questions.prompt: What cannot be concluded from the data?
choices: Registrations increased across the three shown days
Wednesday had more registrations than Monday
questions.explanation: Poster tidak memberi data Jumat sehingga tren setelah Rabu tidak diketahui.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang tidak bisa disimpulkan dari data?

Setiap sesi berlangsung dua puluh menit
Hari Rabu lebih banyak pendaftar daripada Senin
